DetectionParams.description: Settings of puncta detection on one channel.

method.description: Detection algorithm: Local Maxima (fastest, well-separated puncta), Laplacian of Gaussian (blob-aware, crowded fields), Difference of Gaussian (fast blob approximation), Radial Symmetry (high-density fields).
method.label: Algorithm

sensitivity.description: Intensity threshold as a fraction (0-1) of the maximum. Lower values detect dimmer puncta but may increase false positives.
sensitivity.label: Sensitivity (0-1)
sensitivity.title: Sensitivity

min_distance.description: Minimum separation between detected puncta in pixels. Prevents double-counting nearby puncta.
min_distance.label: Min Distance (px)
min_distance.title: Min Distance

sigma.description: Gaussian sigma for detection in pixels. Match to the approximate radius of your puncta. 0 = no smoothing.
sigma.label: Spot Radius, px (Sigma)
sigma.title: Sigma

z_scale.description: Ratio of Z-step to XY pixel size. Corrects for non-cubic voxels. Auto-computed from image metadata when available.
z_scale.label: Z/XY Scale Ratio
z_scale.title: Z Scale

use_tophat.description: Apply white top-hat filter to subtract uneven background before detection.
use_tophat.label: Subtract Background (Top-hat)
use_tophat.title: Use Tophat

tophat_radius.description: Radius of the top-hat structuring element in pixels. Should be larger than puncta diameter.
tophat_radius.label: Top-hat Radius (px)
tophat_radius.title: Tophat Radius

nuclei_only.description: Keep only puncta inside the nuclei mask. Uncheck to detect puncta everywhere.
nuclei_only.label: Nuclei Only (discard outside nuclei)
nuclei_only.title: Nuclei Only

DetectionParams.title: DetectionParams

SegmentationParams.description: Settings of nuclei segmentation for one round.

method.description: Classical: Fast, watershed-based. Cellpose: Deep learning, slower but more accurate.
method.label: Method

merge_splits.description: Merge adjacent labels that one nucleus was split into.
merge_splits.label: Merge Split Nuclei
merge_splits.title: Merge Splits

SegmentationParams.title: SegmentationParams

max_ransac_distance.description: Maximum distance in micrometres for matching centroid pairs between rounds. 0 = auto-detect.
max_ransac_distance.label: Max RANSAC Distance, µm (0=auto)
max_ransac_distance.title: Max Ransac Distance

apply_warp.description: Apply elastic warping for better alignment (recommended). Disable for rigid rotation/translation only.
apply_warp.label: Apply B-spline Warp
apply_warp.title: Apply Warp

ConsensusParams.description: Settings of the consensus nuclei mask.

overlap_method.description: Intersection: Keep only overlapping pixels. Union: Keep all pixels from both rounds.
overlap_method.label: Overlap Method

match_threshold.description: Maximum centroid distance in pixels to match nuclei between rounds. 0 = auto-detect.
match_threshold.label: Match Threshold, px (0=auto)
match_threshold.title: Match Threshold

remove_extranuclear_puncta.description: Remove puncta located outside the merged nuclei mask after matching.
remove_extranuclear_puncta.label: Remove Extranuclear Puncta
remove_extranuclear_puncta.title: Remove Extranuclear Puncta

ConsensusParams.title: ConsensusParams

ColocRule.description: A pairwise colocalization rule: target puncta within ``cutoff_um`` of source puncta.

cutoff_um.description: Maximum distance (in microns) for two puncta to count as colocalized (close together).
cutoff_um.label: Cutoff (um)
cutoff_um.title: Cutoff Um

ColocRule.title: ColocRule

TriColocRule.description: A three-channel rule: anchor puncta within ``cutoff_um`` of both channel A and channel B.

cutoff_um.description: Maximum distance in microns for tri-colocalization.
cutoff_um.label: Cutoff (um)
cutoff_um.title: Cutoff Um

TriColocRule.title: TriColocRule
